svg.text: Add bulk actions to the customer table
agent/bulk-actions · Claude Code · 14 files changed · opened 2 h ago · waiting for review
Selected rows take a tinted ground
Table moves down 52px when the bar shows
BulkActionBar is new, no story yet
Bar padding 14px is off the 4px scale
already covers this. Open in Storybook · Add to return
The table had no way to act on more than one row. I
added a BulkActionBar that appears when any row is
checked, reused Button and Checkbox, and gave Checkbox
an indeterminate state for the header. Delete is muted
so it does not compete with the primary action.
Interaction: 12 tests passed. Pins 6 and 7 have no
visible element; they sit on the bar by convention.
